restrictions: The witness is the ordinary collision of the two distinct 128-byte messages in certificates/manifest.json under standard-IV SHA-256 reduced to steps 0 through 30, with FIPS padding and all 256 digest bits.
time_log2 36.6 and preprocessing_log2 36.6 are the same ceiling. The explicit sum in proof.md is 51583987473.087852 target compressions, whose base-2 logarithm is 35.586204, strictly below 2^36.6.
The scored program is a deterministic replay of that stored pair. Its construction cost is the counted scalar search in proof.md Section 5 plus the one bit-blast solve in Section 6.

The x-dependent search is the scalar loop in search/r31bb.c. It is charged at 960 primitive operations per executed trial. The trial count is 98721333376, the final counter of seed bb310001, including overshoot. No bitslice substitute is claimed.

The bit-blast term charges 7221526979 retired user instructions, doubled for the excluded kernel, at 1024 primitive operations per instruction. 1024 is a uniform cap, not a sample mean. The ceiling 36.6 remains valid if that price is raised to 4096 and the per-trial allowance is raised to 1600 at the same time.
This package claims no full SHA-256 collision and no 32-round collision. The promoted leader at the time of writing is 37.22. It does not resubmit 78c1cb18.

heuristics.statement: The starting solution in search/sp_bb.h was produced by one z3 5.1.0 bit-blast of search/bitblast-model.smt2. That process retired 7221526979 user instructions. Kernel events were excluded, so the term charges that count twice. Each instruction is charged at 1024 primitive operations, the maximum per-form price in promoted filing 50592e75. The term is 2 * 7221526979 * 1024 / 2140 = 6911068809.809346 target compressions and is included in the 36.6 sum.
heuristics.scope: Discovery of the starting solution whose header is search/sp_bb.h. The scalar trial counter is not part of this premise.
heuristics.extrapolation: None. The instruction count is one perf_event_open receipt for that process from exec until exit. The price is a uniform cap applied to every counted instruction, not a mean of a sampled mix.
heuristics.limitations: 1024 is not a disassembly of every opcode. The claimed ceiling remains below 2^36.6 if the price is raised to 4096 and the per-trial allowance is raised from 960 to 1600 together. A substitution past both bounds is outside this claim.
